card.title: Exam bank — every board question on physical quantities

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Three questions: accuracy vs precision with example (2024), homogeneity check of v2 = u2 + 2as (2023), four fundamentals plus kilogram definition (2023). Precision repeats readings; accuracy nears truth. Homogeneity demands every added term share dimensions.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: velocity [LT-1] · force [MLT-2] · energy [ML2T-2] · homogeneity: all summed terms equal · errors: multiply/divide add percent, powers multiply, add/subtract absolutes

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Homogeneity works within one unit system and only constrains sums (meaning dimensionless constants stay invisible). Precision-accuracy examples need a target analogy (clustered off-target = precise, not accurate). Significant figures bind measured digits only.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: v2 = u2 + 2as: L2T-2 everywhere, passes. Clustered-tight-off-centre shots illustrate precision without accuracy. SI fundamentals: m, kg, s, A, K, mol, cd — any four with units answers the 2023 recall.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (3): [v2] = L2T-2, [u2] same, [2as] = L x LT-2 = L2T-2 — homogeneous. NEB 2024 (2): precise-but-biased instrument example (tight cluster off true value). NEB 2023 (2): metre, kilogram, second, ampere plus kilogram definition.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: calling homogeneity sufficient (v = u + 2at passes dimensionally yet errs); units on strain-like ratios; precision confused with accuracy. Dimensionless constants (half, 2 pi) escape the method.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Dimensions derive from definitions (velocity L/T through power ML2T-3); homogeneity checks substitute term by term. Error rules derive from differentials (relative errors add in products, scale by exponents).

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 'Check correctness' means homogeneity first, three lines. Accuracy-precision: draw the target analogy. Fundamentals: any four SI pairs plus the asked definition.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (2): accuracy vs precision + example. NEB 2023 (3): homogeneity of v2 = u2 + 2as. NEB 2023 (2): four fundamentals + kilogram.
